recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7826 unless a future Pharmacy decision changes the MedicationAdministration v2 mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-7826 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 May 2015 ballot asking that the MedicationAdministration quantity v2 mapping remove component references, changing RXA-6-Administered Amount / RXA-7.1-Administered Units.code / RXA-7.3-Administered Units.name of coding system to RXA-6 Administered Amount / RXA-7 Administered Units.
initial_application: Git commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c explicitly listed tracker item #7826 and changed the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet mapping to the requested simplified RXA-6/RXA-7 wording. The later source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced the current StructureDefinition source while preserving the simplified mapping.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml is in current build scope. The element is now MedicationAdministration.dosage.dose rather than the older quantity wording, but the v2 mapping text remains exactly RXA-6 Administered Amount / RXA-7 Administered Units. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or workgroup minutes for FHIR-7826 or this RXA mapping.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source already matches the issue request and no current source hunk is needed.
